- Plan: independently verify the five blocking review findings, re-read the relevant SPEC and package contracts, then correct only findings that hold. Preserve the #98 cosmetic work by reverting this branch's duplicate implementations rather than reconstructing alternatives.
- In progress: required repository guidance and the branch state have been checked; no source changes made in this pass yet.
- Verified findings: all five hold. In particular, `scriptOf` currently reads the process-global catalog version and resumes use current-only `scriptsFor`; server registry does not pass its persisted version to either initial creation or folds. Heroic Power still gets an Activate control on the backrow card as well as the hero button, and the hero also renders additional powers. The hover References panel maps all related faces side by side. `packages/cards/README.md` still describes v0.2.0 as latest. The branch also contains the three cosmetic implementations assigned to #98.
- Next: remove the duplicate #98 implementation files/hunks; then carry a match's catalog version through engine state/instances/resumes and add focused historical-replay coverage; make the hero panel the single power control and collapse related-card display to a one-at-a-time surface.

Updated the registry and recovery tests to prove the process-global catalog cannot choose an old match's Heroic Power script. Fused scripts are also keyed by version; their normal key remains only for existing unpinned fixture states.

- Plan: verify all six review findings against the current branch and governing SPEC sections; make the narrow corrections; run focused tests, then lint, typecheck, catalog validation, rulings coverage, and the suite.
- Done: verified and fixed the locked-drop ordering, R73's ownership contradiction, superseded ownership assertions, and the v0.2.0 snapshot's altered `loc` values. The reviewer misidentified one changed card as `core-004`; base-diff verification found and restored `core-015` instead. Regenerated the derived patch history so v0.2.1 records only #98's `loc` transition. Added the v0.2.1 version expectations.

The targeted cards (90), web drag (43), and server catalog (22) tests pass. A wider patch-history audit also fixed the web newest-version assertions, the older-patch expansion/scoping that a newly auto-opened v0.2.1 exposed, and the server package contract that still called v0.2.0 latest.
- Done: targeted checks after the final snapshot correction: cards 90/90, server catalog 22/22, patch source 7/7, the updated Patch Notes interaction, and changed-file ESLint. Node-loader catalog validation and rulings coverage pass; `git diff --check` is clean.
- Verification limitation: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm validate:catalog`, and `pnpm rulings:coverage` hit `tsx`'s sandbox IPC `EPERM`; equivalent Node-loader checks passed, as did direct engine/cards/server/web TypeScript projects. - Decisions: a catalog-versioned script key (`core-098@v0.2.0`) is selected only when the registered match catalog is v0.2.0; unchanged cards keep their normal script. This avoids changing the current path.
- Dead ends: none.

# Pass 2 notes — issue #49 review findings (bot/issue-49)

## Plan
Answer the 3 blocking findings; nothing else.
1. Client series view: server `projectSeries` now sends `result: {outcome,endReason,ranked}`
   (R612, no hidden rating), but `apps/web` still types/reads `ratingBefore/After` →
   renders "Rating undefined → undefined". Fix `net/api.ts` type + `series.tsx` ratingWords
   to use the `ranked` flag; update `series.test.tsx` + `SeriesBanner.test.tsx` fixtures.
2. e2e `19-queue-modes-and-series.cy.ts` R262 block: local SeriesView type still has the
   removed fields; `moved` computes 0 and `greaterThan(0)` fails at runtime. Replace with a
   `ranked === true` assertion (series is queue-paired, so ranked) + keep season-record-once
   assertions.
3. SPEC self-contradiction: §9.5 bullet (L869), R79 row (L1333), R112 row (L1366) still say
   Elo/K=32; code is Glicko-2 (R603). Also R262 row says "with R79's K, from the ratings
   before its first game" — doubly stale (old code read current ratings at series end too,
   `ratingsOf` on main). Update all four to Glicko-2; no new R-row (correction, not a decision).

## Verified before editing
- Server projection sends exactly `[endReason, outcome, ranked]`
  (`apps/server/src/api/series-rules.ts:635-645`, asserted in
  `series-rules.test.ts:646-647`). Client guard `=== null` lets `undefined` through.
- e2e series under test is queue-paired bo3 (lobby + enqueue) → `ranked` will be true.
- `eloUpdate` fully gone from src/tests; old `ratingsOf` (main) read current ratings —
  R262's "before its first game" was already stale on main.
- Per-game series rows leave ratings unchanged (`results.ts:92-93`); series rated once at
  end from current ratings (`series.ts:planSeriesRating` → `planRankedGame` reads stored
  profiles). New SPEC words must say that.

## Decisions
- Series result line: ranked → "Ranked series: counted as one rated game." (true for
  win/loss/draw/forfeit; mirrors match banner "Ranked match"/"Unranked match" style and the
  e2e "rated once" language). Unranked/abandoned keeps "Unrated: no rating changed."
  Rejected: showing any number (R612 forbids), "your rank moved" (false for draws — pips
  don't move on a draw).
- Keep `ratingWords` name (used once, not imported by tests) to minimize churn.
- SPEC R262 refs column: §9.5, §9.12, R603, R604 (drop R79/R112 — rating no longer theirs).

## Done
- All 3 findings held; all fixed (6 files, +28/-24).
- Client: `SeriesView.result` is now `{outcome,endReason,ranked}`; `ratingWords` returns
  "Ranked series: counted as one rated game." / "Unrated: no rating changed.". Red observed
  pre-fix ("Rating undefined → undefined"), green after (web series+banner+rank+match: 50 passed).
- e2e: local type + `ranked === true` assertion; stale comment fixed.
- SPEC: §9.5 bullet, R79, R112, R262 rows now say Glicko-2; zero "Elo" left in SPEC. No new
  R-row (correction, not a decision).
- Gates so far: server series/ranked 122 passed; rulings:coverage 472/472; lint clean;
  typecheck clean (incl. e2e tsconfig). Full `pnpm test` running in background.

## Next
- Edit api.ts type → tests red → fix series.tsx → tests green → e2e → SPEC → run proofs
  (web series tests, server series tests, lint, typecheck, rulings:coverage).

- runs-on: ubuntu-latest
- timeout-minutes: 10
- steps:
- - uses: actions/checkout@v4
- with:
- fetch-depth: 0
- - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
- - name: promote pending fragments
- run: pnpm --filter @jackioh/cards patches ship
- - name: open promotion pull request
- env:
- GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.BOT_GITHUB_TOKEN || github.token }}
- run: |
- if git status --short | grep -q .; then
- sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
- branch="patches/ship-${sha}"
- git checkout -b "$branch"
- git add -A
- git commit -m "cards: promote pending patch fragments"
- git push -u origin "$branch"
- gh pr create --title "cards: promote pending patch fragments" \
- --body "Automated promotion of merged pending fragments (ship order)." \
- --base main --head "$branch"
- gh pr merge --auto --squash "$branch"
- else
- echo "patches ship: nothing changed"
- fi
- ```
- (Uses a `patches/` branch, never `bot/`, since `bot-commands.yml` treats those as the night bot's; token/auto-merge mirror the bot's own PRs — `deliver.py` enables auto-merge pinned to the approved head. Please adjust to the exact convention if it drifted.)
- **2. In `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, beside `validate:catalog`:**
- ```yaml
- - name: every catalog change is claimed by one pending fragment
- run: pnpm --filter @jackioh/cards patches check
- ```
